Lapland has no radiotherapy unit; all 21 municipalities are treated at OYS in Oulu, 20 beyond the 100 km commuting threshold; Utsjoki is 676 km, 9.4 hours, away [S52, S45, S21, S57, S60].

1. The head of radiotherapy at OYS could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases: equal pain relief, more retreatment [S31, S30, S32]. Within 30 days: add the 5-session option to the OYS breast pathway page; indicator: "patients receive treatment within target times" [S25, S24].

3. The county's data lead, with OYS, could publish yearly schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band; within 30 days, agree bands and the extract; indicator: "regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services" [S21, S26].

Limitation: distances use municipality centre points, patients are allocated by population, and the schedule mix is assumed [S57, S59, S60].
